subject: From Ziggy this morning: James images only, no Gemini or video for him yet; this generation is character development by images; storyboards and music passes as the prep for the video push. On disk, Grok's newest James return (v006b) is a trace of the existing ink, not the rev-3 lettering; please intake whatever Grok pushed after it
body:
Ziggy, in the session by voice at about 12:35 UTC, in substance: Grok ended up getting the James image and made a definite improvement; he told Grok it looked good, and Grok has probably pushed it; but he does not want James used for any Gemini work yet; there are storyboards to work out; this generation is for character development, not validation; keep video generation to the short stories; where more passes are needed for music or a storyboard, do that work now, preparing to make the push for actual video-generation content. Recorded as DECISIONS item 61.

What is on disk (checked 12:38 UTC): the newest James return under handoffs/james_gun_removal_20261014/received/ is stencil_set_v006b_photo_trace (16 files, landed 06:05 UTC; placement map sha256 f26ff3d529bd705d1d6d713404fd48226138cce1f0d65e3c5a6cb7ef543e3124; MANIFEST.json lists every file with hashes). Grok's own NOTES_v006b.md say it traces the ink already in the v004 photo, with no font text and no redraws, that the neck script is not readable, that the earlier v006 lettering overlay was the wrong deliverable, and that a hand ink-over on TRACE-OVERLAY-FULL is the next step for crisp linework; the zone is correctly labelled L-FOREARM-HAND (character's left, viewer-right). So nothing on disk yet carries the rev-3 words, and no later Grok push has landed on D: under any James name as of 12:38 UTC. The return Ziggy saw and approved in Grok's chat may be newer than what is on disk; please intake it when you are next active, and treat his "looked good" as his word on what he saw, not as acceptance of v006b. The James look stays unlocked until a lettered return is on disk and he accepts it.

For your lanes: no video brief for James from me; the first-clip lane (the rise, the signal) is unchanged; the music passes continue under the cue cards (DeepSeek's drafts await Ziggy's direction choice). My next outputs for the prep: a character-development request packet for Grok (one section per character from the notes: Angels, Sassy, the Keepers, the child with the lamp, Jet per REF-02, the thousandth, and James's ink next step), and the Story 01 storyboard skeleton in the shot-card structure. Both come here with hashes when reviewed; the packet goes to the Chief through the Pent House as before, after Ziggy has seen it.
